SELECT r.room_id, r.room_type AS roomType, CASE WHEN r.room_type = 'one' THEN opp.webuser_name ELSE r.room_name END AS room_name,
lm.content AS last_message, lm.created_at AS last_time,
NVL(uc.unread_count, 0) AS unread_count, NVL(cnt.user_count, 0) AS user_count
FROM chat_room r JOIN chat_room_user ru ON r.room_id = ru.room_id AND ru.user_id = #{userId}
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT room_id, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM chat_room_user GROUP BY room_id ) cnt ON cnt.room_id = r.room_id
-- ✅ 1:1 상대 이름 가져오기 (내가 아닌 유저) : one일 때만 붙도록 LEFT JOIN chat_room_user ru2 ON ru2.room_id = r.room_id AND r.room_type = 'one' AND ru2.user_id != #{userId}
-- ✅ 이 줄이 없어서 에러난 거! LEFT JOIN webuser opp ON opp.webuser_id = ru2.user_id
-- ✅ 방별 마지막 메시지 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT room_id, content, created_at FROM ( SELECT room_id, content, created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY room_id ORDER BY message_id DESC ) rn FROM chat_message ) WHERE rn = 1 ) lm ON lm.room_id = r.room_id
-- ✅ 방별 안 읽은 메시지 수 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.room_id, COUNT(*) AS unread_count FROM chat_message m JOIN chat_room_user cru ON cru.room_id = m.room_id AND cru.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.sender_id != #{userId} AND m.message_id > NVL(cru.last_read_message_id,0) GROUP BY m.room_id ) uc ON uc.room_id = r.room_id
ORDER BY lm.created_at DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT r.room_id AS roomId, r.room_type AS roomType,
lm.content AS lastMessage, lm.created_at AS lastTime,
NVL(uc.unread_count, 0) AS unreadCount, NVL(cnt.user_count, 0) AS userCount FROM chat_room r JOIN chat_room_user ru ON r.room_id = ru.room_id AND ru.user_id = #{userId}
-- ✅ 마지막 메시지 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT room_id, content, created_at FROM ( SELECT room_id, content, created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY room_id ORDER BY message_id DESC ) rn FROM chat_message ) WHERE rn = 1 ) lm ON lm.room_id = r.room_id
-- ✅ 안 읽은 메시지 수(last_read 기반) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.room_id, COUNT(*) AS unread_count FROM chat_message m JOIN chat_room_user cru ON cru.room_id = m.room_id AND cru.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.sender_id != #{userId} AND m.message_id > NVL(cru.last_read_message_id,0) GROUP BY m.room_id ) uc ON uc.room_id = r.room_id
-- ✅ 방 인원수 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT room_id, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM chat_room_user GROUP BY room_id ) cnt ON cnt.room_id = r.room_id
WHERE r.room_id = #{roomId}
